cocozhi.name: Cocoa Drink Premix with Ganoderma Extract (Cocozhi)
cocozhi.description: Cocozhi is formulated from the finest cocoa with Ganoderma extract. Besides the excellent Cocoa aroma, the stimulating effect of Ganoderma will make you healthy. Pour the Cocozhi powder in a cup, add hot water/milk and stir. Enjoy the drink Cocozhi. Cocozhi is a delicious Cold Drink too. Ingredients: Sugar, Non Dairy Creamer, Cocoa powder, Vanilla Flavour, Skimmed milk powder, Malt extract and Ganoderma extract (0.6%). Direction: Pour the contents of Cocozhi in a cup, add 150 ml hot water/milk and stir. Suitable for: Drinking (Beverage). Category in Nepal: DFTQC. Caution: NA. Shelf Life: Best Before 36 months from the MFG. Date. Storage: Keep in a cool and Dry Place. Physical Appearance: Pre-Mix Powder form. Colour: Dark Brown.

cordyceps-coffee-3-in-1.name: Coffee Drink Premix With Cordyceps Powder (Cordyceps Coffee 3 in 1)
cordyceps-coffee-3-in-1.description: DXN Cordyceps Coffee 3 in 1 is a mixture of Coffee Powder and Cordyceps. Pour Lingzhi Coffee powder in a cup, add hot water and stir well to enjoy the original taste of DXN Cordyceps Coffee. Ingredients: Sugar, Non Dairy Creamer, Instant Coffee, Mocha Flavour and Cordyceps (0.31%). Direction: Pour the contents of DXN Cordyceps coffee 3 in 1 into a cup, add 150 ml hot water and stir well. Suitable for: Drinking (Beverage). Category in Nepal: DFTQC. Caution: NA. Shelf Life: Best Before 36 months from the MFG. Date. Storage: Keep in a cool and Dry Place. Physical Appearance: Pre-Mix Powder form. Colour & Taste: Dark Brown and Coffee taste.
